intent: One universal face-down Run card that conceals every card identity.

candidates.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: universal face-down card back for a medieval pixel-art tactical game UI
Primary request: Create one complete 5:7 portrait card back, seen perfectly flat and straight-on, with bilateral and rotational symmetry. It should feel like a durable military register or chartulary cover: dark desaturated midnight-blue leather or painted steel, a restrained cold-steel riveted border, small aged-brass corner and clasp details, and a strong central embossed heraldic device built from abstract interlocking lines and one small closed-book clasp motif. The same back conceals every card type, so it must not depict any unit, character, piece type, price, color-coded ability, or card face content.
Style/medium: polished indie-game pixel art with deliberately clustered pixels, crisp hard-edged forms, compact readable silhouette, subtle irregular print-like texture; materially compatible with the existing dark medieval Run card frames shown in this project
Composition/framing: exact 5:7 portrait card rectangle; card fills the canvas edge-to-edge; centered nested border and central medallion; generous simple dark fields so it remains readable when reduced to a tiny deck stack
Lighting/mood: dim cool directional metal highlights, sober, weighty, handled object rather than magical artifact
Color palette: midnight navy, blue-black, gunmetal, restrained tarnished brass; no royal-purple identity and no bright faction color
Materials/textures: worn leather grain or hammered painted steel, darkened rivets, scuffed brass, slight age at the edges
Text (verbatim): ""
Constraints: no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark; no people; no faces; no chess pieces; no crowns; no weapons; no glowing runes; no scene or background outside the card; no perspective tilt; no drop shadow; no transparent margin; no card-face windows; no UI labels. Preserve a clean outer silhouette and exact vertical 5:7 proportion.
